findings.issue: A legacy sibling members table (global_group_members, created by vitana-v1/.../20250917153624_*.sql) is not addressed. The 2025-10-10 migration added the newer global_community_group_members table this spec correctly targets, but the older global_group_members is neither tenant-scoped nor declared out of scope. The spec's four named tables are the right current ones, so this is not a correctness bug; it is a loose end a successor could misread as covered.
